headline: Vote on a school bus violation detection monitoring system, plus 2026-29 strategic plan metrics and FY27 warrant approvals.
summary: Discussion and a possible motion on a school bus violation detection monitoring system are on the agenda. Other items include the 2026-29 SPS Strategic Plan metrics, an MSBA update, and a $1,000 gift to Horace Mann Laboratory School.
items: Consent agenda: approval of FY27 warrants of $806,122.84 (10/8/2026) and $1,037,746.17 (10/15/26)
Establishing metrics for success: the 2026-29 SPS Strategic Plan
Finance and operations report: $1,000 gift to Horace Mann Laboratory School from the Cummings Foundation
Subcommittee reports: finance, personnel, building and grounds, curriculum, and policy
Discussion and motion to approve school bus violation detection monitoring system (M.G.L. ch. 40, Section 71(c)(3))
